conviction_note: A Q1-only print with no revision habit at Q1, a fixed 77-yen dividend and a stock whose last seven measured reactions had a median absolute move of 1.3% (a -65% Q1 OP last year cost only -1.34%); the one sourced bar (IFIS Q1 ordinary 319m) sits at the company's own historic Q1 share of H1 and the evidence on either side of it roughly offsets, so p_up 50 and expected 0 on abs 2.0; impact_sum is +0.05 from two small offsetting findings, consistent with the scaled number.

positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per baseline). 信用倍率 6.0x (baseline; kabutan quote page shows 6.00x on 2026-10-13) -- margin longs crowded relative to shorts, the one setup where a visible miss still has sellers. No options, no skew. Stock -1.1% over 20d but -6.8% from 1,708 (2026-09-24) to 1,592 (2026-10-08) into the print.

findings.finding: The IFIS Q1 ordinary-profit consensus of 319m is 44% of the company's H1 ordinary guide of 730m, while management said in July that new-business contributions build toward H2 (H1 OP 740 vs H2 860) and continuing public/lifeline cuts of 8.2億+7.2億 hit the year; last year's Q1 was only 25% of H1 (135/536), so the quarter carries some downside risk against the street number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26/5 (released 2025-10-10) printed OP 134m, -65% YoY and 12% of the full year; stock moved -1.34% (1,487 -> 1,467, yahoo chart). Q2 FY26 beat its H1 plan: +2.15%. The name's quarterly reactions are small either way.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the H1 guide and last year's Q1 are public and anyone can compute the progress rate, which is why it is sized near zero. What is not in the price is whether Q1 lands below 319 given the back-loaded plan; if the market had priced a miss, the 20-day run-up would be more negative than -1.1% and disclosed shorts would be building, and they are zero.
findings.independence: Back-loading is from the July call transcript (https://finance.logmi.jp/articles/385243, 2026-07-21) and the deck (https://contents.xj-storage.jp/xcontents/AS94590/9e8b8446/2355/4c24/9ff2/08d1b316b84b/20260710120834764s.pdf); the consensus figure is from kabuyoho. Different documents, same issuer.

findings.finding: Q4 FY26/5 OP of 191m included a 1.5億 one-off cost for the Radiant (Malaysia) acquisition, so the underlying Q4 run-rate was about 341m, above the 319m Q1 consensus, and Radiant's revenue consolidates from this Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY results with this Q4 (2026-07-13, 15:30) moved +1.26% next session; Q3 (2026-04-10) +2.72%.
findings.why_not_priced: The one-off is disclosed but sits on a chart slide, not in the headline; kabutan's quarterly table shows only the 191m. Q4 is seasonally busy (March-May), so this run-rate overstates Q1, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: Quarterly OP series from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9216): Q2 FY26 393m, Q3 449m, consistent with a ~340-450m underlying run-rate after the short-term cost plan. Shares the issuer's own numbers.

baseline_tension: Nothing found cuts against the baseline: priced lean -0.33 (margin overhang) and a -1.1% run-up, with zero disclosed shorts; the strongest positive the release could carry is a Q1 at or above the 341m underlying Q4 run-rate with the forecast held, and I looked for a buyback or dividend change and found no sign of one.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a progress rate anyone can compute from the last 短信 is held by the price): the back-loaded-plan negative shrunk from -0.3 to -0.15, p_up moved from 48 to 50, and print_vs_bar from -3 to 0.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives; write the strongest positive): stated in baseline_tension; the positive finding was left at +0.2.
